LOADOUT-INEVITABLE.title: Inevitable
LOADOUT-INEVITABLE.description: Returns to your [gold]Hand[/gold] when [gold]Exhausted[/gold], returns to your [gold]Deck[/gold] when removed, and transforms into a copy of itself.
LOADOUT-STICKY.title: Sticky
LOADOUT-STICKY.description: Returns to your [gold]Hand[/gold] after being played or discarded.
LOADOUT-X_COST.title: X Cost
LOADOUT-X_COST.description: Costs X. This card's effect is repeated X times.
LOADOUT-INFINITE_UPGRADE.title: Infinite Upgrade
LOADOUT-PASSING.title: Passing
LOADOUT-PASSING.description: This card is shuffled into a random ally's [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] after being played.
LOADOUT-LIVID.title: Livid
LOADOUT-LIVID.description: Adds a copy of itself to every player's [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] when played.
LOADOUT-LESSON_LEARNED.title: Lesson Learned
LOADOUT-HEAVENLY.title: Heavenly
LOADOUT-HEAVENLY.description: Double X if it's 4 or more.
LOADOUT-HEAVENLY.cardText: Double X if it's {LoadoutHeavenlyEnergy:diff()} or more.
